summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K attaching its First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release. The release covers routine quarterly financial results: revenue of EUR 125 million, EBITDA of EUR 47 million, and a net loss of EUR 7 million. It also notes an unchanged 2026 guidance and a subsequent extension of a EUR 100 million RCF-B facility to December 2027. No special-situation event — no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return — is disclosed. This filing is a routine earnings update by a foreign private issuer, mapping to a typical quarterly earnings press release.
